term.title: Search term
term.description: The search term this row is for, as resolved from the input (aliases merged and deduped).

outputType.title: Output type
outputType.description: Which of the two datasets this row holds: interestOverTime or relatedQueries.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: The resolved timeRange enum value this row was fetched for.

category.title: Category
category.description: The Google Trends category ID this row was scoped to. 0 means all categories.

status.title: Status
status.description: "ok" (data returned), "no_data" (Google Trends had nothing for this term/range/category, a normal outcome, not a failure) or "error" (the request itself failed).

fetchMs.title: Fetch time (ms)
fetchMs.description: Wall-clock time for the request(s) behind this row. Shown up front so a buyer evaluating us against a tool that times out on a quarter of its runs sees reliability without clicking anything.

charged.title: Charged
charged.description: Whether this row was billed under pay-per-event. Always false for a "no_data" row, and always false while the Actor has no price set.

data.title: Data
data.description: The requested data, shape depends on outputType. interestOverTime: [{time, formattedTime, value, hasData}]. relatedQueries: [{query, value, formattedValue, hasData, link, ranking}], where ranking is "top" or "rising". Omitted from the row when status is not "ok".

error.title: Error
error.description: Set when status is "no_data" or "error", explaining which. Empty when status is "ok".

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One row per search term x output type, with status and fetch time up front.
